journeys.description: The supervisor: greeting, intents, routing rules in order, and the agent each rule hands the call to

journeys.title: 04 Service Questions
journeys.description: Prices, what a service includes, warranty, contracts and parts. 13 cases: 5 agreed, 2 our design, 6 open.

journeys.title: 05 Book A Service

journeys.title: 06 Confirm, Change Or Cancel A Booking

journeys.title: 07 Service Status And Collection
journeys.description: Where the car is, approvals, the bill and collecting it. 6 cases: 3 agreed, 0 our design, 3 open.

journeys.title: 08 Calls We Make
journeys.description: The AI agent calls the customer. In the MVP only if agreed at the scope close on Friday 9 October. 5 cases: 2 agreed, 1 our design, 2 open.

journeys.title: 09 Ai Summit Demo Only
journeys.description: How the demo behaves at the AI Summit. Nothing reaches a real centre or showroom. 7 cases: 5 agreed, 2 our design, 0 open.

cases.when: Calls outside contact centre hours
cases.agent_does: Answers 24/7. Roadside goes to the roadside team.

cases.when: Says roadside
cases.agent_does: Roadside team straight away, before anything else.

cases.when: The voice link is down or slow
cases.agent_does: The call falls back to the contact centre queue, as today.

cases.when: Has a Toyota forklift or a Hino truck
cases.agent_does: Gives the Toyota Material Handling or Hino number. These aren’t serviced at Toyota centres.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Returns a missed call from our number: “someone called me”
cases.agent_does: Finds why we called, a lead, a reminder or a callback, and picks it up. If nothing is found, asks how it can help.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: The first 30 seconds of a call
cases.agent_does: Recognises a chase straight away and follows the chase steps.

cases.when: Picks the wrong menu option to get through faster
cases.agent_does: Goes by what the caller says, not the option they chose.

cases.when: Calls from their registered number
cases.agent_does: Asks which car without listing them, then confirms the plate.

cases.when: Calls for the owner from another number
cases.agent_does: Texts a code to the registered number before sharing car details. If the caller can’t get the code, passes the call to a person.
cases.open_question: When someone calls for the owner, is a code needed before booking?

cases.when: Calls from a number on file, but the profile name isn’t theirs
cases.agent_does: Books on the profile and notifies the branch to fix the name.

cases.when: Wants to change the phone number on their profile
cases.agent_does: Checks the new number with a one-time code.
cases.open_question: Who can currently change the main mobile on a profile: contact centre agents, or only the service centre?

cases.when: Calls for someone else: a spouse, a driver, a fleet
cases.agent_does: Books on the owner’s profile and asks where to send the SMS.

cases.when: Calls from their registered number
cases.agent_does: Profile pulled in the background while the call connects; no one-time code, nothing said until needed.

cases.when: Asks only a general question
cases.agent_does: The profile pulled in the background is never mentioned.

cases.when: The background lookup is slow or fails
cases.agent_does: Carries on as a new caller; looks up again only if a booking needs it.

cases.when: Has a Lexus or another brand on the same number
cases.agent_does: Mentions only the Toyota cars, because the line is Toyota.

cases.when: Two people share one number
cases.agent_does: Asks the name or a plate to tell the profiles apart.

cases.when: Calls from a landline or another number
cases.agent_does: Asks for the mobile the car is registered under and finds the car with it.

cases.when: Unknown number and no registered mobile
cases.agent_does: Carries on as a guest and asks the name when needed.

cases.when: Isn’t found by number or plate
cases.agent_does: Searches by number, plate or VIN digits, and checks SAP for older cars before creating a new profile.

cases.when: Has a warning light, a leak or a noise at any point in the call, or is afraid to drive
cases.agent_does: Understands the warning first. Emergency: sends the emergency walk-in request and passes recovery to the roadside team. A service-due alert: books a normal service.

cases.when: Someone is hurt, or a child or a pet is locked in the car
cases.agent_does: Tells them to call the emergency services first, then connects roadside.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Asks if they are talking to a robot
cases.agent_does: Says it is an AI assistant, in wording agreed with Legal.

cases.when: Switches between English and Arabic
cases.agent_does: Carries on in that language and keeps the context.

cases.when: Speaks Hindi, Urdu or another language
cases.agent_does: Notifies the internal team to call back in Hindi or Urdu.

cases.when: Background noise, or talks over the AI agent
cases.agent_does: Stops, listens and repeats the key detail back.

cases.when: Is abusive
cases.agent_does: Gives one warning, then ends the call politely.

cases.when: Silence, or a bad line
cases.agent_does: Asks twice, then offers a callback or ends politely.

cases.when: The AI agent doesn’t understand
cases.agent_does: Asks to rephrase, at most twice, then passes the call to a person.

cases.when: Several needs in one call
cases.agent_does: Handles one, then asks about the next.

cases.when: Changes their mind mid-call
cases.agent_does: Goes back to the step they want.

cases.when: Off-topic, or testing the AI agent
cases.agent_does: Polite redirect to what it can help with.

cases.when: A system is slow or doesn’t answer
cases.agent_does: Short hold line, one retry, then passes the call to a person.

cases.when: The AI agent passes the call to a contact centre agent
cases.agent_does: Hands the call over with that summary.
cases.open_question: What else does the contact centre need to see?

cases.when: Chases a team for the second time
cases.agent_does: Sends a follow-up email on the second call and raises a complaint on the third.
cases.open_question: Should the second call go to a person instead of a follow-up email?

cases.when: Nobody in the contact centre is free
cases.agent_does: Offers a queue callback when no contact centre agent is free.

cases.when: Wants a callback in the evening
cases.agent_does: Books callbacks 9 am to 6 pm, later only if the customer asks.
cases.open_question: Is this still right?

cases.when: Asks for a person
cases.agent_does: Passes the call to a person, with a summary.

cases.when: Upset or complaining
cases.agent_does: Acknowledges it, then passes the call to a person, with a summary.

cases.when: Wants to raise a complaint, or follow up on one
cases.agent_does: Takes the details and raises it, as the contact centre does today: ticket number by SMS, the complaints team calls within 2 working days. Or passes the call to a person.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Says “stop calling me”, or asks how we got their number
cases.agent_does: Records do not call and confirms it. Questions about their data go to a person.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Needs a hold or a transfer
cases.agent_does: Asked for a manager: arranges a manager callback, not a transfer to another contact centre agent. Asked for a person: transfers.

cases.when: “Which centre is closest to Global Village?”
cases.agent_does: Works out the area from the landmark and suggests the nearest centre.

cases.when: Asks a centre’s hours or phone number, including Fridays, Ramadan and holidays
cases.agent_does: From the 2024 list: most centres Monday to Saturday, 8:30 am to 5:30 pm, closed Sunday. Longer at SZR, 7 am to 7 pm, and Sharjah and Al Badia, 8 am to 8 pm. Open Sundays at Abu Dhabi Airport Road, Sharjah, Al Badia and SZR. Special hours and phone numbers from the knowledge base.
cases.open_question: Is this still right?

cases.when: Asks a showroom’s hours
cases.agent_does: Gives showroom hours from the knowledge base.

cases.when: Unclear if they mean a showroom or a service centre
cases.agent_does: Asks which one.

cases.when: Wants Lexus or another Al-Futtaim brand
cases.agent_does: Takes their details for that brand and gives its number. No transfer.

cases.when: Wants a service booking, now or after the sales part
cases.agent_does: Handles it on the same call.

cases.when: Asks for a named sales executive, or returns a missed call
cases.agent_does: Puts that sales executive on the lead to call back.

cases.when: Existing customer calls from a different number
cases.agent_does: Creates a new customer record.

cases.when: Follows up a request they already made
cases.agent_does: Emails the showroom manager: a call within 24 hours. No new lead.

cases.when: Has bought a car (delivery, plates, invoice, refund) or wants to complain
cases.agent_does: Takes the details and passes them to the right team, with a summary.

cases.when: No longer wants to buy
cases.agent_does: Closes the enquiry with a reason.

cases.when: Wants to move or cancel a test drive
cases.agent_does: Not at launch. It passes the call to a person, who moves or cancels it.
cases.open_question: Can the AI agent move or cancel a test drive itself?

cases.when: Asks about a model, specs, trims or colours
cases.agent_does: Answers from approved content.

cases.when: Asks something the agent can’t answer
cases.agent_does: Says so honestly and passes it to the sales team.

cases.when: Wants help choosing between models
cases.agent_does: Compares them, then offers a test drive.

cases.when: Asks the price
cases.agent_does: Gives the starting price only.

cases.when: Asks about offers or monthly payments
cases.agent_does: Yes to the current offers on the website. For monthly payments and finance, a sales executive calls them back.
cases.open_question: Can the AI agent talk about current offers and monthly payments?

cases.when: Asks showroom locations or hours
cases.agent_does: From approved content, including Ramadan and public holiday hours.

cases.when: Asks about stock, delivery time, a discount or a quote
cases.agent_does: The sales executive confirms.

cases.when: Mentions an offer that has ended
cases.agent_does: Apologises and gives the current offers.

cases.when: Mentions a personal offer they were sent
cases.agent_does: Notes it on the lead for the sales executive.

cases.when: Asks for a model no longer sold
cases.agent_does: Says so and suggests the closest current model.

cases.when: Says a model name the agent can’t catch
cases.agent_does: Asks them to repeat it. Still unclear: asks what they need the car for and suggests a model.

cases.when: Compares Toyota with another brand
cases.agent_does: Gives Toyota facts only.

cases.when: Wants a used car
cases.agent_does: New cars only at launch. For used cars, it gives the number of the used car team.
cases.open_question: Can the AI agent book test drives for used cars, or only new cars?

cases.when: Buying for a company, or a van, bus or pickup
cases.agent_does: On the corporate list: fleet sales. Otherwise: a business lead to the showroom.

cases.when: Doesn’t want the showroom to call
cases.agent_does: No lead. Gives the showroom number.

cases.when: Wants a test drive or to buy
cases.agent_does: Name, mobile, model, when they plan to buy, cash or finance, any trade-in, preferred showroom.
cases.open_question: What must the AI agent ask before passing the customer to the showroom?

cases.when: Already has an open lead
cases.agent_does: Add it to the existing lead if it’s less than 30 days old, so the same sales executive keeps the customer.
cases.open_question: Should the AI agent add this to the lead from two weeks ago, or create a new lead?

cases.when: Shows interest in buying
cases.agent_does: Yes. Today every enquiry is marked Hot, so we keep that. When they plan to buy is noted on the lead.
cases.open_question: Should this be marked as a Hot lead?

cases.when: Plans to buy later
cases.agent_does: Notes when to call back, with their OK.

cases.when: Wants to buy now
cases.agent_does: A callback. The AI agent tells the caller when to expect the call.
cases.open_question: Should the AI agent put the call straight through to the showroom, or arrange a callback?

cases.when: Wants to sell their car
cases.agent_does: Only selling: no lead; details passed to Automall for a valuation. Selling to buy: noted on the lead as a trade-in.

cases.when: Wants to buy a car to export
cases.agent_does: Explains Toyota doesn’t sell cars for export.

cases.when: Wants a visit only, two models, or a test drive at home
cases.agent_does: Only at the showroom. If they ask for one at home, the AI agent notes it and the showroom calls them to arrange it.
cases.open_question: Can the AI agent book test drives at home, or only at the showroom?

cases.when: Is young, or has no UAE licence
cases.agent_does: A valid UAE driving licence is needed. Sales to tell us the minimum age showrooms use today.
cases.open_question: What is the minimum age for a test drive?

cases.when: Books for someone else
cases.agent_does: Takes the driver’s name and mobile.

cases.when: Names a showroom, or wants the nearest
cases.agent_does: Any model on the website. The sales executive confirms availability.

cases.when: Wants today, after work or a Saturday
cases.agent_does: Offers the nearest free time.

cases.when: Wants a specific grade, engine or colour
cases.agent_does: Notes it on the lead for the showroom.

cases.when: Nothing suits
cases.agent_does: Notes the time they prefer. The showroom calls back.

cases.when: Is ready to book
cases.agent_does: Reads back the details and reminds them to bring their licence and Emirates ID.

cases.when: Picks a time
cases.agent_does: The showroom confirms it first, so the customer is never promised a car that isn’t free.
cases.open_question: Is the booking confirmed on the call, or does the showroom confirm it first?

cases.when: Loses the time they picked to someone else, mid-call
cases.agent_does: Checks again and offers the next free time.
cases.open_question: Can a test drive time be held while the customer books?

cases.when: Booking doesn’t save
cases.agent_does: Says plainly it isn’t booked and passes to a person.

cases.when: Wants the details
cases.agent_does: SMS. One message with the day, time, showroom map link and what to bring, saying whether it’s confirmed or the showroom will confirm.
cases.open_question: How should the customer get the booking details: SMS or WhatsApp?

cases.when: Finishes the call
cases.agent_does: Offers the short survey.

cases.when: Has been passed to the showroom
cases.agent_does: The lead carries the call summary, so the customer never repeats themselves.

cases.when: Waits for the showroom’s call
cases.agent_does: Within 60 minutes if the showroom is open. If it’s closed, first thing the next morning. If the customer asked for a time, at that time.
cases.open_question: How soon should the sales executive call the customer?

cases.when: Isn’t reached by the showroom
cases.agent_does: The sales manager checks it before it’s closed and notes the reason. If a test drive is booked, the lead stays open.
cases.open_question: What should happen to the lead?

cases.when: Has had the test drive
cases.agent_does: The showroom records the outcome on the lead.

cases.when: Asks the price of the service
cases.agent_does: Gives the service price only if asked, from SAP. If they don’t book, emails the branch. Extra work: adds it to the booking without a price; if they insist, emails the branch for a callback.

cases.when: Asks how long the service will take
cases.agent_does: Doesn’t commit to a time and says the service advisor will confirm it.

cases.when: Asks what the 40,000 km service includes
cases.agent_does: Says what the service includes from that service data.

cases.when: Wants to buy a service contract
cases.agent_does: Not handled by the AI agent yet: passes the call to a person.

cases.when: Wants a service contract refunded or transferred
cases.agent_does: Explains the process, documents and fees, then advises a visit. Transfer: both owners attend, AED 158, 3 to 4 weeks. Refund: AED 205 with the documents, 3 to 4 weeks.

cases.when: Asks for their service history
cases.agent_does: Never reads out the full history or invoices; asks them to visit the centre with the Mulkiya and ID.

cases.when: Asks the price of recovery by truck
cases.agent_does: By recovery truck, to or from our centres: AED 150 within the emirate under 50 km; AED 250 under 100 km, including between emirates; AED 150 Sharjah to Ajman. Same-day needs 2 hours’ notice. None after 2 pm in Ramadan.
cases.open_question: Is this still right? Over 100 km, is it not offered, or charged at a different rate?

cases.when: “Is this covered by warranty?”
cases.agent_does: Gives the warranty end date; the centre confirms cover.

cases.when: Asks a part’s price, or whether a part is in stock
cases.agent_does: Sends a parts enquiry to the parts team, as the contact centre does today; they reply within 1 working day.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Asks for a replacement car while theirs is in the workshop
cases.agent_does: Says what’s offered, if anything; otherwise passes the call to a person.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Wants to extend the warranty
cases.agent_does: Gives the price by model and cover, 1 or 2 years, as the contact centre does today, or passes the call to a person.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Asks about an offer their car or purchase doesn’t qualify for
cases.agent_does: Says the offer doesn’t apply and gives the current offers.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Needs help with the connected car app
cases.agent_does: Gives the app support number and hours, and emails the request, as the contact centre does today.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Has a company car
cases.agent_does: Finds it by plate and registered mobile, confirms the car, and books with the driver’s name and phone on the booking.

cases.when: Bought the car used and wants to book a service before it’s in their name
cases.agent_does: Asks if they are the new owner, confirms the car, books under the new owner’s profile, creating one if needed, with the car details in the notes, and says the owner change is done at the centre with the Mulkiya, ID and a fee.

cases.when: Has a non-GCC car: US, Canadian or European spec
cases.agent_does: Doesn’t book. Says their details go to the team for imported cars, emails the Auto Center, and gives its toll-free number.
cases.open_question: What should the future process be? Can a service centre accept a walk-in at its discretion?

cases.when: Has to spell out an email address
cases.agent_does: No email on the call. The SMS carries a link to add to calendar, reschedule, cancel or track.

cases.when: The car already has a future booking
cases.agent_does: Reads it out and offers to change it; one booking per car.

cases.when: Bought the car but it isn’t in their name yet
cases.agent_does: Books as a guest with name, plate, phone and kilometres.

cases.when: The plate is misheard
cases.agent_does: Reads it back in short chunks; after two tries, passes the call to a person.

cases.when: A guest already has a booking for that car
cases.agent_does: Checks for a duplicate by plate and phone before choosing the centre; offers to change it.

cases.when: Car bought outside Al-Futtaim, GCC spec
cases.agent_does: Books the regular 10K service only.

cases.when: The car on file is wrong or exported
cases.agent_does: Doesn’t book on that car, asks which car, and flags the record.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Has a leased car
cases.agent_does: Passes the call to a person until agreed.
cases.open_question: The contact centre suggests a person handles leased cars. Agreed?

cases.when: Wants the car moved into their name
cases.agent_does: Says the owner change is done at the centre with the Mulkiya, ID and a fee, and books a service if they want one.
cases.open_question: Should we plan an AI-supported or self-service owner change after launch?

cases.when: Wants a warranty or recall visit, not a service
cases.agent_does: Checks the car record and that the recall isn’t done. Safety recalls go to the centre now. Books running recalls; otherwise sends an enquiry to the service centre. Gives warranty dates with a note that the centre confirms.
cases.open_question: Should the AI agent book every running recall, or does the brand confirm each car first? What wording should the warranty date disclaimer use?

cases.when: Gives a mileage that differs from the record
cases.agent_does: Proposes the next service from the history and books with the caller’s mileage. Not sure: gives the last visit’s mileage; still unsure, notes Unsure KM for the service advisor. Price only if asked.

cases.when: Has a prepaid service contract
cases.agent_does: “Your 40,000 km service is already paid”

cases.when: Passed the due mileage
cases.agent_does: Suggests the right service: “the 50,000 or the 60,000?”

cases.when: Doesn’t know the mileage
cases.agent_does: Asks once, then adds a No Mileage note.

cases.when: The next service isn’t due yet
cases.agent_does: Gives the interval and the next date.

cases.when: Adds a concern, like a brake noise, and the car is safe to drive
cases.agent_does: Sends it in the booking notes for the centre.

cases.when: Books a second car in the same call
cases.agent_does: Finishes the first, then starts the next.

cases.when: Wants only tyres, a battery or an AC check, not a service
cases.agent_does: Books a visit with the job added to the booking, as the contact centre does today.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Can’t renew the registration: an RTA block for an open recall
cases.agent_does: Handles it like any recall booking. If it’s already done, asks them to visit the centre to update it.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: Needs a speed limit certificate for a company car
cases.agent_does: Checks the branch offers it, then books with a note, as the contact centre does today.
cases.open_question: How often does the contact centre get this call?

cases.when: The car is at the body shop, or needs accident repair
cases.agent_does: Existing case: gives the status if it can, and the tracking portal. New case or callback: passes the call to a person.
cases.open_question: Is this the right split: existing cases get the status and the portal, new cases go to a person?

cases.when: Has a car or job that only some centres take
cases.agent_does: Books only at a centre that can do the job, and offers the nearest one.
cases.open_question: Which centres do hybrid, electric, GR and commercial work? Which Toyota centres take Coasters?

cases.when: Has a Supra due a service
cases.agent_does: Books a Supra only at Al Badia, SZR or Wave, for the next service in its history.

cases.when: Wants a smart repair, polish, detailing or tint at SZR on a Sunday
cases.agent_does: Not booked on Sundays at SZR.
cases.open_question: Is this still right?

cases.when: Books any service: pick-up and drop-off

tools.name: get_queue_status

tools.description: Check whether the contact centre queue is open and whether an agent is free right now. Use before handing a call to a person so a queue callback can be offered when nobody is free.

params.name: queue

tools.result: {open: boolean, agents_available: number, estimated_wait_seconds: number}

tools.name: schedule_callback
tools.signature: schedule_callback(callback_type: string, mobile_number: string, reason: string, summary: string, preferred_time?: string, language?: string, customer_name?: string) -> {scheduled: boolean, callback_id: string, scheduled_for: string}
tools.description: Arrange a call back to the customer. Callback type is one of queue_callback (nobody free), manager_callback (asked for a manager), bad_line. A sales callback travels on the lead, and a Hindi or Urdu callback is a send_team_request. The backend enforces the callback window, per current policy. Returns the time the customer will be called (scheduled_for, ISO 8601 with +04:00) so it can be read back.

params.name: callback_type
params.note: Kind of callback, from the list in the description

params.name: mobile_number
params.note: Number to call back, E.164

params.name: reason
params.note: Why the callback is needed, in a few words

params.name: summary
params.note: What happened on this call so the person calling back does not ask again

params.name: preferred_time
params.note: Time the customer asked for, ISO 8601 with +04:00, when given

params.name: language
params.note: Language to call back in: en or ar

params.name: customer_name
params.note: Customer's name, when known

tools.result: {scheduled: boolean, callback_id: string, scheduled_for: string}

tools.name: create_complaint
tools.signature: create_complaint(mobile_number: string, category: string, details: string, customer_name?: string, plate_number?: string, centre_id?: string) -> {created: boolean, ticket_number: string, response_time: string}
tools.description: Raise a complaint ticket with the complaints team, as the contact centre does today. Returns the ticket number and, in words, when the complaints team will call (response_time). The complaints system sends no SMS for a ticket the AI agent raises: send the ticket number with send_customer_message, template complaint_ticket. A repeat problem or a bill higher than quoted goes to the service advisor with send_team_request unless the caller asks to complain.

params.name: mobile_number
params.note: Customer's mobile number, E.164

params.name: category
params.note: One of service_quality, repeat_problem, billing, delay, staff_conduct, sales, delivery, unanswered_request, other, per current policy

params.name: details
params.note: The complaint in the customer's words, with dates and the centre or showroom involved

params.name: customer_name
params.note: Customer's name, when known

params.name: plate_number
params.note: Plate of the car concerned

params.name: centre_id
params.note: Service centre or showroom concerned: a centre_id from find_service_centres or a showroom_id from find_showrooms, when known

tools.result: {created: boolean, ticket_number: string, response_time: string}

tools.name: get_open_requests
tools.signature: get_open_requests(mobile_number?: string, customer_id?: string, reference?: string) -> {total: number, requests: {request_id: string, type: string, team: string, created_date: string, chase_count: number, status: string, summary: string}[], last_outbound_call_reason: string, last_outbound_call: {reason_code: string, record_reference: string, called_at: string, team: string}}
tools.description: Find what is already open for this caller: earlier team requests, callbacks, complaints, and why we last called them. Give at least one of mobile_number, customer_id or reference. Use when the caller is chasing a team, following up, or returning a missed call from our number. type is one of team_request, callback, complaint. team is a team from send_team_request, or a queue from get_queue_status for a callback. status is open or in_progress, per current policy. last_outbound_call says why we last called: reason_code is one of lead, booking_reminder, callback, survey, other, and record_reference is the lead, booking or callback it was about; its fields are empty when we did not call. last_outbound_call_reason is the same reason in words.

params.name: mobile_number
params.note: Caller's mobile number, E.164

params.name: customer_id
params.note: Customer profile identifier from lookup_customer_by_phone or search_customer, for a caller on another number

params.name: reference
params.note: Request identifier or complaint ticket number the caller reads from the SMS

tools.result: {total: number, requests: {request_id: string, type: string, team: string, created_date: string, chase_count: number, status: string, summary: string}[], last_outbound_call_reason: string, last_outbound_call: {reason_code: string, record_reference: string, called_at: string, team: string}}

tools.name: record_chase
tools.signature: record_chase(request_id: string, summary: string) -> {chase_count: number, action_taken: string, action_code: string, ticket_number: string, expected_response: string}
tools.description: Record that the customer chased an open request again. The contact centre rule decides the action from the chase count, per current policy. action_code is one of none, followup_email, complaint; action_taken says the same in words so it can be said on the call. When a complaint is raised, ticket_number is its ticket and expected_response says in words when the complaints team will call.

params.name: request_id
params.note: Open request identifier from get_open_requests

params.name: summary
params.note: What the customer said on this call

tools.result: {chase_count: number, action_taken: string, action_code: string, ticket_number: string, expected_response: string}

params.name: mobile_number

tools.result: {do_not_call: boolean}

tools.name: record_do_not_call

params.name: mobile_number

params.name: requested_by

tools.result: {recorded: boolean}

tools.name: log_call_disposition

tools.description: Close an outbound call on one of today's contact centre disposition codes.

params.name: disposition_code

params.name: mobile_number
params.note: Number that was called, E.164. Empty only when the call record carried no number

params.name: call_reference
params.note: Identifier of this outbound call from the dialler, when the campaign supplies one

params.name: record_reference
params.note: Booking reference or lead identifier the call was about, when there is one

params.name: call_purpose
params.note: Why the call was made: one of booking_reminder, web_lead, missed_call_callback

params.name: callback_time
params.note: Time the customer asked to be called again, ISO 8601 with +04:00, for callback_requested

params.name: notes
params.note: One sentence on the outcome

tools.result: {logged: boolean}

tools.name: get_contact_number
tools.signature: get_contact_number(contact_key: string) -> {found: boolean, team_name: string, phone_number: string, hours: string}

params.name: contact_key
params.note: Team whose number the caller needs, from the list in the description

tools.result: {found: boolean, team_name: string, phone_number: string, hours: string}

tools.name: lookup_customer_by_phone
tools.signature: lookup_customer_by_phone(phone_number: string) -> {found: boolean, profile_count: number, customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, preferred_language: string, toyota_vehicle_count: number, future_booking_count: number, open_lead_count: number}
tools.description: Look up the caller's customer profile by the phone number they are calling from. Runs silently when the call connects. Returns only Toyota vehicles and bookings because this line is Toyota. Never read the result out unless the caller needs it. When profile_count is not 1, customer_id, first_name and full_name are empty; use search_customer with the name or a plate.

params.name: phone_number
params.note: Caller's phone number in E.164 format, for example +971501234567

tools.result: {found: boolean, profile_count: number, customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, preferred_language: string, toyota_vehicle_count: number, future_booking_count: number, open_lead_count: number}

tools.name: search_customer
tools.signature: search_customer(mobile_number?: string, plate_number?: string, vin_last_digits?: string, full_name?: string) -> {total: number, single_match_customer_id: string, single_match_first_name: string, matches: {customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, name_matches: boolean, mobile_last_digits: string, source_system: string}[]}
tools.description: Search for a customer profile by registered mobile, plate number or the last digits of the VIN, including older cars held only in SAP. Use when the caller's number is unknown, a landline, shared by two people, or when a profile must be found before creating a new one. A mobile number, a plate or VIN digits is always needed: a name alone is not searched. single_match_customer_id and single_match_first_name are the one profile found; they are empty unless total is 1. name_matches says whether the name given in full_name matches the profile. source_system is crm or sap.

params.name: mobile_number
params.note: Mobile number the car is registered under, in E.164 format

params.name: plate_number
params.note: Vehicle plate as spoken by the caller, emirate code and number, for example Dubai A 12345

params.name: vin_last_digits
params.note: Last six digits of the vehicle identification number

params.name: full_name
params.note: Caller's name, used only to tell apart two profiles that share one number

tools.result: {total: number, single_match_customer_id: string, single_match_first_name: string, matches: {customer_id: string, first_name: string, full_name: string, name_matches: boolean, mobile_last_digits: string, source_system: string}[]}

params.name: full_name

params.name: mobile_number
params.note: Customer's mobile number in E.164 format

params.name: plate_number

Use before booking to prevent a duplicate, before retrying a failed booking, and to find the booking a caller wants to confirm, change or cancel. start_label is the start time in words, for the read-back. minutes_until_start counts from now and is negative once the time has passed. can_change is true while the booking can still be changed or cancelled, per current policy. channel is one of phone, whatsapp, website, branch. customer_name and belongs_to_customer_id say whose booking it is; booked_by_name is the person who made it for them, or empty.

tools.name: create_service_booking
tools.signature: create_service_booking(slot_id: string, plate_number: string, contact_name: string, contact_mobile: string, service_code?: string, visit_type?: string, recall_ids?: string[], hold_id?: string, replaces_booking_reference?: string, customer_id?: string, vehicle_id?: string, current_km?: number, mileage_status?: string, notes?: string, extra_jobs?: string[], express?: boolean, preferred_advisor?: string, pickup_dropoff?: boolean, pickup_address?: string, pickup_time?: string, customer_waits?: boolean, booked_for_owner?: boolean, booked_by_name?: string) -> {booked: boolean, booking_reference: string, status: string, start_time: string, start_label: string, centre_name: string, failure_reason: string}
tools.description: Create the service booking. Call only after the caller confirmed the full read-back of car, service, centre, day and time. One booking per car. visit_type is one of service (default), job_only, recall, warranty_check; service_code is required only for service. To change centre, pass replaces_booking_reference: the old booking is cancelled in the same transaction. The notes carry concerns, driver details and anything the centre must know. When pick-up and drop-off is accepted, the centre arranges the chauffeur after the call. status is confirmed when booked is true, and start_label is the booked time in words. When booked is false, failure_reason is one of slot_taken, hold_expired, duplicate_booking, not_allowed, validation; it is empty on success. The booking system sends no SMS: send the confirmation with send_customer_message.

tools.description: Change the date, time, jobs, notes or pick-up and drop-off of an existing booking at the same centre. A change of centre is a new booking instead: call create_service_booking with replaces_booking_reference. When pick-up and drop-off is added, the centre arranges the chauffeur after the call. Removing a chauffeur pick-up close to its time returns the late-cancel fee, per current policy. start_label is the time of the booking after the change, in words. When updated is false, failure_reason is one of slot_taken, job_not_allowed, too_late, validation; it is empty on success. The booking system sends no SMS: send the new confirmation with send_customer_message.
